senses.gloss: , (כַּדּוּן Ms.) (contr. of כְּעַידַּן, v. כְּעַן; cmp. הָאִידְּנָא) now, at that time.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:4">Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:6">6</cite> (O. <cite ref="K00968"><he>כְּעַן</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="P01528"><he>עתה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 13:7">Targ. Y. Gen. XIII, 7</cite> <he>עד כ׳</he> as yet; a. fr.—Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ bot. <he>דעד כ׳ וכ׳</he> for up to that time people are awake.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 2:1:5">Y. Ḥall. II, beg. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>עד כ׳ לחה</he> thus far (so much about) fresh flour.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:2:11">Y. Sot. V, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כ׳</he> right now, opp. <he>בתר זמן</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 25:6">Ps. XXV, 6</cite>) <he>לא מן דכ׳ וכ׳</he> not from this day, but from eternity; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 702:5">Yalk. Ps. 702</cite> <he>מן הדין</he> (read: <he>מן כ׳</he>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:21">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> <he>מאי כ׳</he> how is it now? (what is the result, the law &c.?); Y. Peah IV, 18ᵇ bot. <he>מיי כ׳</he>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 6:1:10">Y. Ter. VI, 44ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ולית אתון אמרין מהָן כ׳ ונתן וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M00347"><he>מהו</he></cite>) and you did not say whence it was derived. Now (I will tell you, We read,) ‘and he shall give’ &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 6:1:10">Ib.</cite> <he>ולית אתון מיניהון מהו כ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
